free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the evidence strongly supports further investigation due to a PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right mid-peripheral zone and a rising PSA trajectory. This finding, combined with the fact that the prior biopsy was negative, mandates a repeat sampling to rule out missed disease. The PI-RADS 4 score and the PSA trend (0.5 to 0.76 ng/mL over ~2 years) are the decisive factors driving this recommendation.
